# Requirements Quality Checklist: Request Aliases

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the XEN-016 requirements — data integrity of the request file, tab/draft UX, and security
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist` and then run against spec.md, plan.md, research.md and contracts/. Each tick
says what makes the item pass; items that failed on the first run were fixed in the artifacts before ticking.

## Requirement Completeness — data integrity

- [x] CHK001 Are all sendable fields an alias carries enumerated, so "full copy" has no unlisted field? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — FR-001 lists method, URL, params, path variables, headers, disabled auto-headers, body, auth, scripts, inherit-scripts, settings; data-model.md `RequestAlias.Version`.
- [x] CHK002 Are the request-level fields that aliases share (and do not copy) defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004] — name, description, id, examples, location.
- [x] CHK003 Is independence specified in both directions (alias → Default/others, Default → aliases)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003] — FR-003 + US2 AS1–AS2; research R2 names the mechanism.
- [x] CHK004 Is stale-write protection specified for every alias write (create, save, delete), not only save? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009] — failed on first run (save only); FR-009 now covers create/save/delete and both banner actions.
- [x] CHK005 Is the effect of an alias write on the other versions' revision and drafts defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009] — FR-009: every version adopts the new revision, others keep drafts; research R3.
- [x] CHK006 Is the file layout of aliases specified precisely enough to be written byte-for-byte? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — data-model.md YAML sample and key order (`examples`, `aliases`, `postman`, `bruno`).
- [x] CHK007 Is the order of aliases (in the file and the dropdown) defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-010] — creation order / file order.
- [x] CHK008 Is the alias identity rule (stable id, unique within the request, never shown) stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK009 Is "a request without aliases is written exactly as today" measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, US6 AS5] — byte-for-byte for saves, exports and syncs, including after the last alias is deleted (quickstart step 7, T012).
- [x] CHK010 Are the alias name rules quantified (length, case, whitespace, reserved word) with a distinct error per rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] — 1–200 chars trimmed, case-insensitive uniqueness, "Default" reserved; codes `ALS-03400/04400/05409` in contracts/bindings.md.
- [x] CHK011 Is "copy of the saved Default" unambiguous about unsaved Default edits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, US1 AS3] — unsaved Default edits are not copied.
- [x] CHK012 Are the title and History label formats specified exactly (separator, order)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-017] — `<request> · <alias>` (U+00B7, research R11).
- [x] CHK013 Is the Postman export naming specified, including a name collision with an existing sibling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018] — failed on first run (collision undefined); FR-018 now says the name is used as is.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Are "one tab per request" and the existing "Duplicate tab" command consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Clarifications] — failed on first run; FR-012 now says aliases never open tabs and Duplicate tab copies versions.
- [x] CHK015 Do the rename rules for the alias crumb and the request name avoid two pending names in one tab? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-011] — failed on first run; FR-011 now makes the request name plain text while an alias is shown.
- [x] CHK016 Are the name rules identical for the UI and MCP? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024] — FR-024 applies FR-005; contracts/mcp.md uses the same codes.
- [x] CHK017 Is the Git-sync merge behaviour stated consistently in Context and FR-021? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021] — both say file-level conflict as today (fixed after analyze).
- [x] CHK018 Are the different label formats (`·` in app, `( )` in Postman export) intentional and recorded? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-018] — user decision for export, research R11.

## Scenario Coverage — tab and draft UX

- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for switching versions with unsaved edits on either side? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, US2 AS4] — no prompt, drafts kept per version.
- [x] CHK020 Is the tab's dirty state defined across versions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, US2 AS5]
- [x] CHK021 Are the close prompt's Save / Don't Save outcomes and partial-failure behaviour defined? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-013] — failed on first run (partial failure undefined); FR-013 now specifies order, stop-on-error and the tab staying open.
- [x] CHK022 Is restore after restart defined, including a remembered alias that no longer exists? [Recovery, Spec §FR-014, US4 AS4]
- [x] CHK023 Are opening-from-sidebar and new-tab starting versions defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, US4 AS2–AS3]
- [x] CHK024 Is preview-tab pinning on alias actions defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014a]
- [x] CHK025 Is Save As from an alias defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014b]
- [x] CHK026 Are delete confirmation, cancel and "deleting the shown alias" outcomes defined, including its unsaved draft? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, US3 AS5] — dialog text in contracts/ui.md.
- [x] CHK027 Is the inline error behaviour for invalid names defined for both create and rename? [Exception Flow, Spec US1 AS7, US3 AS2]
- [x] CHK028 Is the alias being deleted or changed elsewhere (git pull, MCP, another tab) while shown covered? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-014] — falls back to Default; FR-009 for stale writes.
- [x] CHK029 Are unsaved requests and example tabs explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Are keyboard and screen-reader requirements stated for the dropdown, ⋯ menus and dialogs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010] — failed on first run (only in contracts); FR-010 now states keyboard operation and accessible names.

## Scenario Coverage — boundaries

- [x] CHK031 Are export (Postman, Xenon) and import (Postman, Bruno, cURL, Xenon) outcomes for aliases all specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018–FR-020]
- [x] CHK032 Is a Postman round trip of exported aliases specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018] — failed on first run; FR-018 now says re-import creates separate requests.
- [x] CHK033 Are duplicate, move, rename of the request and the documentation tab covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022, §FR-022a, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Is sending defined for the alias's own scripts and the variables they set? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015b, US1 AS5] — user decision: per-alias scripts, no alias variable scope.
- [x] CHK035 Is behaviour for an unknown alias on send defined (nothing sent)? [Exception Flow, Spec US7 AS4, contracts/bindings.md `Send`]

## Non-Functional — security

- [x] CHK036 Do alias fields fall under the same secret rules as the Default (files, exports, logs, snippets)? [Security, Spec Edge Cases "Secrets", Constitution II] — same model and paths; plan Constitution Check II.
- [x] CHK037 Is the MCP leak guard explicitly required for alias content? [Security, Spec §FR-023] — failed on first run (contracts only); FR-023 now requires it.
- [x] CHK038 Are OAuth 2.0 token ownership, refresh and cleanup defined per alias? [Security, Spec §FR-015a] — user decision; research R12 pins the owner id and cleanup on delete.
- [x] CHK039 Is the Postman export guaranteed to carry no secret value for alias requests, with literal credentials in alias auth warned about? [Security, Spec US6 AS1, §SC-006, research R8]
- [x] CHK040 Are AI sends of an alias subject to "Confirm before send" approvals and recorded as AI activity? [Security, Spec US7 AS2–AS3]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK041 Is the dependency on XEN-012 click-to-rename behaviour stated? [Dependency, Spec §FR-007] — names the pattern; its contract is `specs/XEN-012-click-to-rename/`.
- [x] CHK042 Is older Xenon reading a file with aliases explicitly scoped out with a reason? [Assumption, Spec Edge Cases] — auto-updater (XEN-013).
- [x] CHK043 Is the Postman-parity exception recorded as a user decision? [Dependency, Spec Context, §FR-026, Constitution VI]
- [x] CHK044 Is the absence of a limit on aliases per request a stated assumption? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Edge Cases]
